title: Political economy
author: William Stanley Jevons

authorInfo.bio: William Stanley Jevons (1835–1882) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Political Economy" by William Stanley Jevons is a scientific publication likely written in the late 19th century. This work serves as an introduction to the principles of political economy, aiming to clarify how wealth is generated, distributed, and consumed within societies.
